_readme: Community Gallery manifest for 3RIC Studio. Each entry becomes a card on gallery.html with a one-click 'Run & Remix' link into the in-browser editor. To feature your own program: add its .s source under codegen/programs/ (build.ps1 stages every codegen/programs/*.s into web/programs/) and append an entry below, then open a pull request. Fields: title (required), author, authorUrl, mode (Hi-res|Lo-res|Text|Serial), description, tags[]; and a run target of either src ('programs/<name>.s') or an inline code (URL-safe base64 for ?code=), plus an optional org (hex load address, only when the source has no .org directive).

entries.title: Built from Bits
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: A one-minute 65C02 showreel: starfield, 16-color plasma, rotating wireframe, and an original six-voice stereo chiptune. Every pixel and note runs on the CPU. Use 1x and click the screen for sound; 1-4 selects scenes, N/Right advances, Left goes back, Space pauses, M mutes, Q/Esc quits.

entries.title: 3RIC Groovebox
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Six-voice, 16-step stereo groovebox on the real Mockingboard interface. Make beats with a gamepad or keyboard; click once for sound and use native 1x speed.

entries.title: Hello, KansasFest 2026
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: 3RIC Studio's zero-install greeting to the Apple II crowd for KansasFest 2026 — a framed text welcome you can run, remix, and re-share right in the browser. No install, no account.

entries.title: Matrix Rain
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Falling green code with bright heads and fading trails, drawn entirely by the 6502. Runs at native 1x speed; SPACE pauses/resumes, Q or Esc quits.

entries.title: STAR DUEL
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Two-player gravity war around a central sun. Rotate, thrust, and fire with two SNES pads or a split keyboard; wrap the playfield and don't fall into the well. First to 5 kills wins. Q/Esc quits.

entries.title: PULSAR DUEL
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Two darts trapped in the gravity well of a pulsar. You start in orbit, not at rest — thrust changes your orbit, it doesn't steer you. Torpedoes fall toward the well too, so bank them around it. Two SNES pads or a split keyboard; the playfield wraps on both axes. Hyperspace gets you out of trouble one time in eight it doesn't. First to 5 wins; Q/Esc quits.

entries.title: Swarm
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Space-invaders-style fixed shooter — hold the ground line against a descending alien swarm.

entries.title: Rocks
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Vector asteroids-style shooter — rotate, thrust with real inertia, and blast splitting rocks.

entries.title: Jungle Quest: Sunstone Run
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Six-screen jungle platformer — master jumps, duck bats, release a vine, recover four glyphs, and open the Sun Temple.

entries.title: Snake
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Classic snake — grow by eating food, steer with the arrows or WASD; Q quits.

entries.title: Game of Life
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Conway's Game of Life on a toroidal 40x48 colour grid; press SPACE to reseed.

entries.title: Blocks
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Falling-block stacker — clear lines in a 10x20 well before the pieces reach the top.

entries.title: Bricks
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Brick-breaker — clear the wall with a bouncing ball and a paddle.

entries.title: Paddles
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Two-paddle tennis — first to 7 points wins.

entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: The classic 4x4 2048 sliding-tile puzzle — combine tiles to reach 2048.

entries.title: Minesweeper
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: Turn-based Minesweeper on a 16x16 board — flag the mines and clear the field.

entries.title: Hello, world
entries.author: 3RIC Studio
entries.description: A tiny greeting printed via COUT ($FDED), then BRK back to the monitor — the perfect starting point for your first 3RIC program.

entries.title: Bouncing Ball
entries.author: scottybe
entries.description: Like the Amiga demo but not an illusion - a bouncing, rotating checkerboard ball rendered live in 3D on the 65C02. Optimized for over 10x fewer CPU cycles at native speed. Any key exits.
